commit_message: Enforce required ADR 0110 packaged Humanoid bakes
pr_body: Implements ADR 0110 Humanoid profiles and skeleton-independent motion. This packaging follow-up traces statically reachable Animation Set sources using the same Native / explicit RetargetMap / Humanoid priority as runtime, blocks packaging when a required portable motion or target HumanoidProfile cannot produce its bake, and shares scene/prefab traversal with existing retarget reachability. PR remains Draft; merge is manual.
